strings.statistics.active_days_30: Active days in the last 30 days
strings.recent.title: Recent registrations
strings.upload.description: Upload an audio recording – it will be analysed automatically and added to the statistics.
strings.upload.formats: Supported formats: WAV, M4A, MP3 and AAC. Maximum {max_mb} MB.
strings.privacy.hide.title: Hide short-term activity
strings.privacy.hide.description: New registrations are stored but permanently hidden from short-term and date-specific views. Aggregate activity is published in monthly, yearly, and total figures after {min_hours}–{max_hours} hours. The mode turns off automatically after {mode_hours} hours.
strings.privacy.pause.title: Pause registration
strings.privacy.pause.description: Rejects new browser uploads and pauses queue processing. Registration starts automatically again after {pause_hours} hours.
strings.privacy.reset.title: Reset short-term view
strings.privacy.reset.description: Reset the short-term view. Monthly, yearly, and total figures are retained.
strings.disclaimer.text: This is an experimental tool for learning and informal statistics. It may count incorrectly and is not an official shot log. Do not use it as a safety system or as the basis for compliance, billing, or enforcement decisions.
strings.privacy.enable_confirm: Hide short-term activity for up to {hours} hours?
strings.registration.enable_confirm: Pause registration and uploads for up to {hours} hours?
